gaps: RECOVERY_VERIFIER_STATIC_TOKEN_ONLY_GAP
The recovery verifier proves source text tokens and pinned blobs but does not consume the four runtime receipts or prove that recovery actually ran.
Require strict parsing of all four fresh receipts and make static checks only a prerequisite.
RECOVERY_VERIFIER_REQUIRED_RECEIPT_SET_GAP
The verifier does not require 015, 016, 014 and 003 receipts to exist, be non-empty and form one accepted generation.
Bind the exact four paths, hashes, generation and terminal statuses before PASS.
RECOVERY_VERIFIER_CONTINUATION_KEY_GAP
Verifier output and input checks omit the canonical continuation_key.
Require the same continuation key in queue, restart request, every receipt, heartbeat, claim and verifier output.
RECOVERY_VERIFIER_NONCE_FRESHNESS_GAP
No invocation nonce, monotonic sequence or bounded timestamp window prevents replay of an old successful receipt.
Issue one recovery nonce and require fresh ordered timestamps and nonce equality across all receipts.
RECOVERY_VERIFIER_OWNER_HEARTBEAT_CLAIM_GAP
The verifier never proves a fresh daemon heartbeat and exact task/attempt claim after restart.
Require fresh owner, heartbeat and claim bound to PID, process start time and continuation.
RECOVERY_VERIFIER_REMOTE_HEAD_ORIGIN_GAP
The verifier does not inspect the configured origin URL or prove local/remote HEAD readback at verification time.
Pin repository identity, origin fetch/push URLs and exact remote HEAD immediately before verdict.
RECOVERY_VERIFIER_QUEUE_REQUEST_BLOB_GAP
Queue and restart request JSON content is read but their exact Git blob identities are not pinned by the verifier.
Pin and verify queue/request blobs from the authoritative commit before parsing.
RECOVERY_VERIFIER_JSON_STRICTNESS_GAP
json.loads accepts duplicate keys and non-standard numeric constants by default.
Use duplicate-key and parse_constant rejection plus an exact schema for all control records.
RECOVERY_VERIFIER_OUTPUT_ATOMICITY_GAP
Verifier output is written directly with write_text and has no flush, atomic replace or generation manifest.
Publish through a unique same-volume temp file, fsync, atomic replace and remote hash readback.
RECOVERY_VERIFIER_OUTPUT_PATH_CONTAINMENT_GAP
--output is arbitrary and is not proven to remain inside an authorized slot path after symlink or reparse resolution.
Require an exact relative output path and final-handle containment under the slot output root.
RECOVERY_VERIFIER_OBJECT_FORMAT_GAP
Git blob computation is hard-coded to SHA-1 and does not inspect the repository object format.
Read extensions.objectFormat and verify blobs using Git's declared object algorithm.
RECOVERY_HELPER_NON_DAEMON_ZERO_EXIT_GAP
One matching non-daemon canonical process causes helper exit 0 even though no persistent daemon exists.
Return blocked non-zero and require an explicit healthy persistent daemon state.
RECOVERY_HELPER_PROCESS_QUERY_FAIL_OPEN_GAP
Get-CimInstance errors are silenced; an unavailable process inventory can appear as zero processes and trigger a start.
Treat process inventory failure or incomplete fields as blocked fail-closed.
RECOVERY_HELPER_PROCESS_IDENTITY_GAP
Process matching relies mainly on command-line regex and omits executable path, parent PID, creation time and file identity.
Require exact executable, canonical arguments, parent lineage, creation time and signed/hash identity.
RECOVERY_HELPER_POST_START_TOTAL_COUNT_GAP
After startup only persistent daemon count greater than one is blocked; total canonical process count can exceed one.
Require exactly one total canonical process and exactly one daemon after stabilization.
RECOVERY_HELPER_HEARTBEAT_CLAIM_GAP
Helper success requires process visibility only and does not verify a fresh daemon heartbeat or task claim.
Require remote heartbeat plus exact task/attempt/continuation claim before success.
RECOVERY_HELPER_RECEIPT_GENERATION_GAP
Restart receipt lacks continuation key, recovery nonce, process start time, executable hash and generation identity.
Add one strict generation-bound receipt with full process and invocation identity.
RECOVERY_OPERATOR_ORIGIN_URL_GAP
Recovery fetches named remote origin without verifying fetch and push URLs belong to the canonical repository.
Pin and receipt exact canonical origin URLs before fetch or merge.
RECOVERY_OPERATOR_STASH_IDENTITY_GAP
After stash push the code accepts current refs/stash without proving it is the newly created stash or binds the captured dirty set.
Record old/new stash OIDs, message, parents and a manifest of preserved paths and hashes.
RECOVERY_OPERATOR_HELPER_HASH_TOCTOU_GAP
The helper file is hashed and later executed by path, leaving a change window between verification and execution.
Execute immutable verified bytes or revalidate the same opened file identity at process creation.
RECOVERY_OPERATOR_PROCESS_TREE_TIMEOUT_GAP
Timeout handling stops only the direct git/helper PID, not descendants.
Use a Windows Job Object or equivalent process-tree ownership and terminate the whole tree.
RECOVERY_OPERATOR_EXCLUSIVE_LOCK_GAP
No exclusive recovery lock prevents two operator invocations from stashing, fetching or starting concurrently.
Acquire a nonce-bound exclusive lock with PID/start-time validation before any mutation.
RECOVERY_OPERATOR_RECEIPT_DURABILITY_GAP
Snapshot and recovery receipts use direct Set-Content without durable atomic replacement or remote manifest binding.
Use Flush(true), atomic replace and one remote generation manifest containing all receipt hashes.
MANUAL_ACTION_RESOLUTION_TRANSACTION_GAP
The OPEN manual action has no implemented transaction that proves 4/4 receipts, fresh claim/heartbeat and accepted output before RESOLVED.
Define a fail-closed resolver that advances OPEN to RESOLVED only through optimistic remote readback of the complete evidence set.
